data.action: 海滨温泉木台上披肩捧热可可，向镜头举杯分享冬日温暖
data.description: 【海滨温泉小镇·黄昏】玛夏穿着浅棕泳装与厚披肩坐在海边温泉木台，双手捧着热可可，雪花落在卷发上；她把杯子朝镜头轻轻举起，像邀请远行的人一起分享温暖。
data.lighting: blue dusk, warm steam and lantern light
data.mood: 学姐式的温柔海滨假日
data.promptProse: Maria sits on the seaside hot-spring wooden deck in a brown resort swimsuit wrapped with a thick cream shawl, holding hot cocoa in both hands. Snowflakes settle on her curls as she gently raises the cup toward the camera. The horizontal medium view places deck boards beneath her and steaming water beyond. Lantern light warms the mug and shawl edge, while blue dusk defines the snowy shoreline behind.
data.title: 玛夏 · 冬日海湾的披肩与热可可
